attchmntText: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Pondy Oxides and Chemicals Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors held the meeting on 12th November 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 1,63,868.68 lakhs. Net profit was 5,636.54 lakhs. Earnings per share was 7.39. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 10,814.26 lakhs as at 30th September 2026. The company also approved a stock split of equity shares from a face value of Rs. 5 to Rs. 2. This split was approved by shareholders through postal ballot.
